# Contribution policy

We welcome ideas, bug reports, and feature requests. \
Your participation helps strengthen the project and refine its direction.

## GitHub pull requests

**GitHub pull requests are different here**: they are treated as **proposals**, not direct merges.

- We will review submissions for relevance and alignment with project goals.
- If accepted, the idea will be **reimplemented internally** and synced outward.
- Direct merging on GitHub is not possible. \
  If we could disable PR merging entirely, we would.

## Attribution

Contributors whose proposals are accepted will be acknowledged, either in commit
messages, release notes, or project documentation. \
We want to make sure recognition is preserved, even though the code itself is
reauthored internally.

## Licensing

By submitting an issue, feature request, or pull request, you agree that your
contribution is provided under the same license as the project.
This ensures consistency and avoids ambiguity in how contributions are used.
